The project's cover coding rates DZ5u1gbI4fE as 3d_render ('clean CG interior render look (flawless gold-veined marble, uniform cove lighting) with added sparkle particle effects; no AI mention in caption', cover watermark '@Luxuryhouseview'). It rates DTa6Fw6iCrI as ai_generated ('smeared/warped details, implausible glowing floor inset mirroring the chandelier, over-smooth glossy surfaces; not disclosed in caption'). Two more covers were viewed from the local cache on 2026-09-25 and also look synthetic: DQ2vN1BCCZn, a bedroom under a star-field / Milky Way ceiling with teal LED coves, and DOkAk0DCK8j, a snowy double-height chalet lounge with a cartoon on the TV. No caption seen discloses AI or rendering, and no creator is credited.
